linux.post_install: unpack() { if unzip -tq "$1" > /dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -oq "$1"; else tar -xf "$1"; fi rm -f "$1" } url="$(curl -fsSL https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links | python3 -c ' import json, sys for link in json.load(sys.stdin)["result"]["links"]: if link["downloadType"] == "serverBedrockLinux": print(link["downloadUrl"]) ')" # Keep the settings files when updating; the zip contains fresh copies of them. mkdir -p gse-keep for file in server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then cp "$file" gse-keep/; fi done curl -fL --retry 3 -o gse-download "$url" unpack gse-download cp gse-keep/* . 2> /dev/null || true rm -rf gse-keep
